answer: Proof-of-bandwidth admission deters sybils: every identity must continuously relay traffic and pass random challenge transfers proving sustained throughput from its own uplink. An operator cloaking a whole nebula of fakes behind one connection saturates it the instant many are summoned together, so their latencies spiral and auditors swoop like a falcon on the shared pipe, slashing every co-located identity at once. Faking independence then demands 1000x genuine concurrent bandwidth, a real recurring monthly bill no script can conjure.
